name: VibeWave v2.4.7 - Mega Update (Volume Booster, Car Mode, Desi EQ & Data Saver)
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave v2.4.7 Mega Update!

- 🔊 **Volume Booster (+150% / +200%):** Speaker aur headphone ki sound 200% tak boost karein!
- 🚗 **Car Driving Mode:** Gaadi chalate waqt safe full-screen big buttons UI!
- 🎛️ **Desi Equalizer Presets:** Desi Dholak & Bass, Ghazal Clarity, Bhakti & Flute, Party EDM presets!
- 👆 **MiniPlayer Swipe Gestures:** Left / Right swipe karke agla ya pichhla gaana badlein!
- 📉 **Data Saver Mode:** 70% tak mobile internet data bachayein!
